# GEO report: acme-mugs **New to GEO?** GEO (generative engine optimization) means making your site easy for search engines and AI tools to find, read and quote. This report checks the technical basics. ## Code score: 24–33/100, At risk Confidence: High (checked 21 of 23 points). How it's calculated: low = 5.5 ÷ 23 × 100 = 24. High = (5.5 + 2) ÷ 23 × 100 = 33. All results are read from code. `robots.txt` tells every crawler to stay away, so the score is capped at 40 until that is fixed (the blocker on GEO-009). The page content also appears only after JavaScript runs. The one unknown is the canonical link (GEO-015), because no site domain is declared anywhere. ## Live check - **Not run.** To add it, give me your site's URL. ## Do these first ### 1. Let crawlers in: remove the site-wide block in robots.txt - **Why it matters:** `Disallow: /` tells every search and AI search crawler not to read any page. This is probably unintended for a shop. - **Where:** `public/robots.txt:2` - **What the code says:** `Disallow: /` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 50–59 (GEO-009 and GEO-014 both become Clear). It also lifts the cap. ### 2. Make the page content visible without JavaScript - **Why it matters:** The server sends an empty `
`. Crawlers that don't run JavaScript see no mugs, no headings and no text. The catalogue is also fetched in the browser. - **Where:** `index.html:8` and `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:6` - **What the code says:** `
` and `fetch('/api/mugs')` inside `useEffect` - **Size:** Large (prerender the pages or move to a server-rendering setup) - **Score after this:** 37–46 on its own. ### 3. Give the site a real title, description and language - **Why it matters:** Every page shares the title "Vite App", and there is no description and no `lang` attribute. Machines can't tell what the site is, or which language it's in. - **Where:** `index.html:2-5` - **What the code says:** `Vite App` on `` with no `lang` - **Size:** Small - **Score after this:** 33–41 on its own. Each page will still need its own title. ## All results | Rule | What it checks | Code | Live | Where | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | GEO-013 | robots.txt is valid and readable | Clear | Not run | `public/robots.txt`, valid lines | | GEO-009 | Search crawlers have the access you intend | Problem | Not run | `public/robots.txt:2`, assumed you want to be found | | GEO-014 | Listed and linked pages are indexable | Problem | Not run | 2 of 2 routes blocked by `robots.txt:2`, no noindex tags | | GEO-015 | Absolute canonical link | Can't tell | Not run | No canonical in `index.html` and no site domain declared | | GEO-003 | Content is in server HTML | Problem | Not run | `index.html:8`, 2 of 2 routes | | GEO-004 | JSON-LD is valid | Not applicable | Not run | No JSON-LD found | | GEO-011 | Sitemap exists and is listed | Problem | Not run | No sitemap, no `Sitemap:` line | | GEO-012 | Title, description, lang | Problem | Not run | `index.html:2,5` | | GEO-016 | Key pages reachable by real links | Problem | Not run | `src/main.jsx:11`, 1 of 1 non-home route | | GEO-017 | No snippet restrictions | Clear | Not run | No nosnippet, no header-setting code | | GEO-002 | Basic accessibility | Problem | Not run | `src/pages/Home.jsx:5` has an image with no alt; Catalogue and Nav read and clear, so 1 of 2 routes | | GEO-101 | Mobile app association files | Not applicable | Not run | No app declared | | GEO-010 | llms.txt (information only) | Not applicable | Not run | Not present, not scored | ## Other problems found - **Catalogue link is only a button:** `src/main.jsx:11`: ``. Use `Catalogue` so crawlers can follow it. - **Image with no description:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:5`: ``. Add `alt` text. ## Worth considering - **Catalogue text only exists after a fetch:** `src/pages/Catalogue.jsx:11`: `{items.map((m) =>

{m.name}

)}`. The page shows only mug names. Giving each mug its own address with a description and price might help people and machines understand the shop. - **Home page has little to say:** `src/pages/Home.jsx:6`: `Thrown by hand in Bristol and shipped worldwide.` Visitors would likely ask about prices, sizes, care and delivery. Answering those in text might help. - **Site address isn't declared:** `package.json` and the config have no site URL. Declaring one would let canonical links and the sitemap use the right domain. - **Viewport meta tag is missing:** `index.html:4`: ``. Adding `viewport` helps pages render properly on phones. ## Can't tell from code - **GEO-015 (canonical):** no domain is declared. Tell me your site's domain and I can re-check. - **Bot protection:** code can't show whether a CDN or firewall lets real crawlers through. Run `geopilot logs ` to check real crawlers against their published addresses. - **`/api/mugs`:** the catalogue data comes from a backend that isn't in this repository. ## Assumptions - You want search engines and AI search tools to find this shop. If the site is meant to be private for now, the `robots.txt` block is deliberate. - The routes are `/` and `/catalogue`, taken from `src/main.jsx`. No other routes exist. ## What to do next 1. Run the geopilot `fix` command to apply item 1. You'll see every change before anything is written. 2. Run the geopilot `explain` command with any rule id, such as `GEO-014`, to learn more. 3. For proof from a running site, ask for a live scan with its URL. Technical readiness only. GEO does not measure or predict citations, rankings, traffic or inclusion in any AI or search product.
